jobs.description:
Founded in 1974, CMiC today delivers comprehensive and advanced enterprise and field operations solutions, purpose\-built for construction and capital projects companies. CMiC’s powerful software transforms how firms optimize productivity, minimize risk and drive growth by planning and managing all financials, projects, resources, and content assets \- all from a single database platform.


In the past several years, the construction industry has experienced unprecedented changes driven by new technologies \- including integration with multi\-dimensional modeling, an explosion of cloud\-based offerings and the demand for robust mobile capabilities. CMiC has kept pace by constantly upgrading and enhancing our advanced platform to reflect the changing needs of the industry, *leading to significant growth as a company.*

**Important Information:**


The overall hiring salary range for this position is $45,000 to $55,000 annually.


This position is for an existing vacancy


We do not use AI to screen, assess, or select applicants

 **Position Scope**


We are seeking enthusiastic, talented people to ***act as the first point of contact when our customers have inquiries or encounter issues as they use our software****.*


**Product Analysts** receive tickets and analyze screenshots and details of customer issues, to replicate the problem while proactively communicating with CMiC teams to guide issues to resolution. In addition to providing a very high level of client service, you will develop strong relationships with clients and staff and provide feedback on documentation. Individuals applying for this position must be able to multi\-task, have a strong attention to detail, professional demeanor, and be able to adapt into a growing and changing environment.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Answer client queries and provide basic direction and training on common issues
* Triage product queues and prioritize issues according to their severity
* Conduct web meetings with customers to gather information for investigative purposes or to provide assistance
* Test and duplicate issues in order to document and demonstrate the problem to other teams such as programming
* Participate in project and team meetings; interacting and collaborating with team members
* Leverage and contribute to the Knowledge Base to assist with the resolution of issues
* Relay feedback to Product Managers so that the product can be improved
* Provide feedback to supervisors and managers regarding processes that are unclear and need to be changed

**This role is for you if:**

* You would rather spend most of your time on challenging issues rather than handling simple support requests
* You want to engage in a collaborative environment with helpful co\-workers and accessible leaders and managers
* You prefer to work for a company that listens to its staff and continues to work toward being a Great Place To Work

  

**Requirements**  

* **French language skill (spoken and written) is a must**
* College/University Degree
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal \& written
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills
* A passion for exploring new software, ability to grasp new concepts and learn quickly
* Extremely detail oriented with the ability to manage and prioritize workflow
* Facilitate communication of information between team members and Product Groups
* Previous technical support experience or customer service experience
* Able to operate in a fast\-paced environment
* Team\-player, strong work ethic and a positive attitude

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive benefits Package (including Health \& Dental benefits)
* Paid vacation and personal days
* Townhall meetings where all employees are encouraged to participate in open discussions
* Outdoor lunch space, including picnic tables
* An active Social Events Committee (past events include annual seasonal parties, pool and bowling tournaments, karaoke nights, Game nights, BBQs, and more)
* Health and wellness webinars
* RRSP Matching Program after 2 years of employment
* Experience in a rapidly growing, socially responsible corporation


CMiC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code, CMiC will provide accommodation to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources staff of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require.

jobs.title: Service Desk Technician
SME - IT Operations Management, RESTful API, Angular
jobs.description:
SME \- IT Operations Management, RESTful API, Angular
Ontario Centre Queensville, Ontario
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Subject Matter Expert (Tools \& Automation) plays a critical role in ensuring timely and quality resolution of escalated incidents and tickets. This position focuses on leveraging deep expertise in SNOW \- ITOM and Rest/Soap API to drive efficient problem\-solving while enhancing customer satisfaction. The role involves mentoring, documentation, and effective communication with stakeholders to uphold service excellence.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Analyze And Resolve Escalated Incidents In Snow \- Itom According To The Agreed Sla, Ensuring Adherence To Quality Compliance And Contributing To Overall Service Delivery.
  

2\. Mentor Team Members And Administrators On Best Practices In Tools And Automation, While Preparing Standard Operating Procedures (Sops) And Maintaining Comprehensive Documentation For Seamless Knowledge Transfer.
  

3\. Validate Change Order Implementation Plans And Ensure Compliance With Human Error Protocols, Actively Participating In Capacity Planning Discussions To Optimize Resource Allocation.
  

4\. Foster Positive Customer Relationships By Actively Participating In Meetings, Understanding Client Issues, And Driving Solutions That Enhance Customer Satisfaction And Feedback.
  

5\. Conduct Thorough Analyses Including Root Cause Analysis And Trend Analysis, Presenting Findings And Performance Reports To Key Business Stakeholders To Facilitate Informed Decision\-Making.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Proficient In Snow Itom And Rest/Soap Api With A Solid Understanding Of Their Application In Incident Management And Automation Processes.
  

2\. Strong Analytical Skills With The Ability To Conduct Root Cause And Trend Analyses.
  

3\. Excellent Communication And Presentation Skills For Effective Stakeholder Engagement.
  

4\. Familiarity With Documentation Standards And Practices In It Operations.  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Itil Foundation Certification Is Optional But Valuable.
  

2\. Relevant Certifications In Servicenow Or Automation Tools Are Recommended

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist – Software
jobs.description:
**About Mobiltex**

Mobiltex is an IIoT and software company delivering remote monitoring and software solutions that help maintain pipeline health for industries delivering critical services. Individual solutions target corrosion prevention, gas pressure management, and water network optimization, primarily serving midstream and downstream energy operators, and water utilities.

Mobiltex is a high\-growth company in an active phase of product and organizational scaling, with potential for M\&A, as well as a growing international footprint. This is an environment that rewards people who can build structure where it doesn’t yet exist, and drive commercial output as the organization scales.

**Role Summary**

The **Technical Support Specialist** **– Software** is a frontline role responsible for delivering technical support and training, while serving as a critical link between the customers and service, engineering, sales, and product teams. It combines software support expertise with customer engagement to support deployment, adoption, and ongoing performance of IoT solutions across our energy and water verticals.

This is an early\-career role in the support team, reporting to the Support Manager. It's a strong entry point for someone with technical skills who enjoys working with people to build product and troubleshooting expertise and grow into a senior support or implementation role over time. The primary focus will be support of Mobiltex software and will include some support of Mobiltex hardware devices. This position is also a great fit for corrosion/CP field professionals looking to move into support, or for IT helpdesk, telecom, electronics, or customer service people with strong technical curiosity; we'll train the domain side either way.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support across the software portfolio: primarily CorInsights, and also FloInsights, Osprey, and future products. Secondarily, provide hardware support as needed for CorTalk, FloPath, and future products.
* Respond to support tickets with a focus on responsiveness, clarity, and resolution quality.
* Communicate clearly with customers, translating technical issues into understandable terms and helping customers use our products successfully.
* Diagnose problems methodically and identify root causes, workarounds, and solutions.
* Escalate complex or high\-impact issues to senior support, management, sales, or engineering.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with the product, development, and QA teams as needed to investigate bugs and contribute to ongoing software improvements.
* Monitor key performance metrics and service levels to ensure you consistently meet or exceed personal targets and company targets.
* Utilize and continuously improve internal documentation, knowledge bases, and support protocols by following Mobiltex standards for formatting, creation, and peer review.
* Participate in customer meetings or presentations when needed to resolve high\-stakes support issues or build customer confidence.
* Provide occasional after\-hours or on\-call support for critical or high\-impact issues.
* Minimal travel (5% or less) for customer meetings, team meetings, and industry events.

**How You'll Work**

You will use phone, email, and ticketing systems to communicate with customers and track resolutions and defects internally. There will be occasional opportunities for on\-site customer engagement. Strong verbal and written communication skills are fundamental to success.

You'll learn and use AI tools like Claude and Copilot alongside standard support tools to work faster and more consistently: drafting case responses, summarizing ticket threads before escalation, searching the knowledge base for similar issues, and generating first\-draft articles from resolved cases for peer review and publishing.

If you are based in Calgary, your first three months will have more office\-based work to get hands\-on training and learn alongside the team. After that, you'll work a hybrid mix of office and home days.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in software customer support or service technician roles.
* A bachelor's degree, diploma, AMPP CP1 or CP2 certification, certification in a related field, or equivalent experience in pipeline monitoring, industrial software, or related fields.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience providing phone or email support to customers in a remote work environment and/or with remote teams.
* Experience with support ticketing systems, remote desktop tools, and diagnostic utilities (Salesforce, Teams, Slack, Jira, Confluence).
* Troubleshooting skills with knowledge of SaaS platforms, APIs, and database technologies.
* Knowledge of and/or willingness to use, create, and promote knowledge bases and AI tools (Claude, Copilot).

Location: Calgary; Remote considered

**What Mobiltex Offers**

* A role in a company actively reshaping how critical infrastructure is monitored and managed.
* Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over commercial messaging and market presence.
* A function with clear scope and a defined growth path as Mobiltex scales – with senior leadership visibility from day one.
* Competitive compensation including base salary and performance incentives.
* Hybrid flexibility with periodic travel to trade shows, team meetings and customer events.

Mobiltex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to mental or physical disabilities, family status, marital status, sex or gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, religion or creed, nationality or citizenship, national or ethnic place of origin, ancestry, or race or color.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

* Have you used tools such as Jira, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or

jobs.title: IT Technician
jobs.description:
IT Technician – L1/L2

**Company:** ExcellIT  
**Location:** Brampton, ON  
**Work Setting:** Onsite at Client Location  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About ExcellIT

ExcellIT is seeking a reliable, hands\-on **IT Technician** to join our growing team. The successful candidate will work **onsite at one of our client locations in Brampton**, providing professional technical support directly to end users.

This is a client\-facing position requiring strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate more complex issues.

The Role

As an **L1/L2 IT Technician**, you will provide day\-to\-day technical support for the client's employees, systems, hardware, and software. You will be responsible for resolving issues efficiently, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring users receive a professional and positive IT support experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **Level 1 and Level 2 technical support** to onsite users
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues
* Troubleshoot Windows desktops, laptops, monitors, printers, and peripherals
* Install, configure, maintain, and deploy computers and other IT equipment
* Provide support for **Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and other business applications**
* Assist with user account creation, password resets, permissions, and access issues
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, printers, and basic network connectivity
* Perform workstation setups, upgrades, replacements, and device imaging
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding of employees
* Manage and update support tickets with accurate notes and resolutions
* Maintain IT asset and equipment documentation
* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior IT staff or external vendors when required
* Provide professional, courteous, and timely onsite customer service
* Assist with IT projects, deployments, and other technical tasks as required

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* **1–3\+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, or a similar role**
* Demonstrated **L1/L2 troubleshooting experience**
* Strong knowledge of **Windows 10/11**
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft 365**
* Experience troubleshooting computers, printers, peripherals, and common software issues
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals, including **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, and VPN**
* Familiarity with **Active Directory / Entra ID** is an asset
* Experience working with an IT ticketing system is an asset
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong customer service skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently in an onsite client environment
* Ability to prioritize multiple requests and manage competing deadlines

Assets

* CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Microsoft certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Intune
* Experience with Active Directory / Entra ID
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration
* Previous MSP or managed IT services experience
* Previous experience providing onsite client support

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **professional, dependable, personable, and technically capable**. You should enjoy helping people, be comfortable working directly with clients, and have the confidence to troubleshoot issues independently.

The successful candidate will represent **ExcellIT** directly at the client site, so professionalism, communication, and customer service are just as important as technical ability.

Work Location

**Brampton, Ontario – Onsite at Client Location**

This is an **onsite position** and requires the successful candidate to be comfortable working at the client's location on a daily basis.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed. Qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Pay: $50,000\.00\-$55,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (Microsoft & End-User Support)
jobs.description:
**About RebalanceMD**

RebalanceMD Victoria is a specialty care clinic where physicians, surgeons, physiotherapists, and allied health professionals work together as one multidisciplinary team. At RebalanceMD, patients can access coordinated care through an integrated model designed to support assessment, treatment, recovery, and ongoing health. Behind that care is a strong technology foundation and commitment to innovation that keep our clinical and administrative teams connected, secure, and able to deliver an exceptional patient and provider experience.

We are seeking a Technical Support Specialist who is passionate about technology and service, and who understands the critical role IT plays in a healthcare environment. This role is instrumental in ensuring our clinical and administrative teams can operate seamlessly, securely, and without disruption.

**About the Role**

As a Technical Support Specialist at RebalanceMD, you will be the first point of contact for technical support across the organization. You will provide timely, professional assistance to a diverse group of users including doctors, clinicians, administrative staff, and leadership.

This role requires a strong foundation in Microsoft technologies, hands\-on support of end\-user hardware, and the ability to work within a fast\-paced clinical environment where responsiveness and reliability are essential. Experience with Apple devices is also valuable, as our environment includes a mix of platforms.

Success in this role requires excellent communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a commitment to supporting healthcare teams in delivering high\-quality patient care.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Tier 1/2 support to clinical and administrative staff via in\-person, phone, email, and ticketing system
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues with a strong sense of urgency and professionalism
* Support Microsoft technologies including Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint), and Active Directory/Entra ID
* Set up, configure, and maintain end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices
* Support both Windows\-based systems and Apple devices within a clinical and office environment
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, including account provisioning, equipment setup, and access management
* Ensure all systems and devices comply with organizational security standards and healthcare privacy requirements (e.g., PHIPA/PIPEDA awareness)
* Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, resolutions, and IT procedures within the help desk system
* Perform routine maintenance, updates, and patching to ensure system stability and security
* Support clinical workflows by minimizing downtime and ensuring critical systems remain operational
* Educate staff on best practices for technology use, security awareness, and basic troubleshooting

**Qualifications \& Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and a minimum of 2 years' experience in an IT help desk or end\-user support role

* Strong experience supporting Microsoft environments, including Windows OS and Microsoft 365
* Working knowledge of Entra ID user and device management
* Experience supporting end\-user hardware such as laptops, desktops, printers, and mobile devices
* Familiarity with Apple macOS and basic troubleshooting of MacBooks
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including Wi\-Fi, VPN, and TCP/IP
* Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly and respectfully support non\-technical users in a clinical setting
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to prioritize and respond effectively in time\-sensitive situations
* A customer\-focused mindset with a high level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail

**Nice to Have**

* IT certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Microsoft certifications, or similar

jobs.title: Support Analyst - Red Lake ON
jobs.description:
EVERY WEEKEND IS A LONG WEEKEND AT FSET

**About FSET Inc**
------------------


FSET Inc is an ISO 27001:2022 certified Managed Services Provider headquartered in Kenora, serving law enforcement, healthcare, municipal and First Nations clients across Canada since 1999\. Our work includes the patented ConnectedOfficer Program, cybersecurity services and cloud infrastructure, delivered by a team of more than 30 people, all based in Canada.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


We are hiring a Support Analyst to live and work in Red Lake, Ontario. This is a permanent, full\-time, home\-based position. You work from home and go onsite to FSET clients in Red Lake and neighbouring communities, including Pikangikum First Nation, where we support a number of community organizations.


You are often the only FSET person on site, which makes network troubleshooting central to the job. When a site loses connectivity, you work the fault from the cable to the carrier: confirm the link, check addressing, DNS and the gateway, test at the internet connection, and establish whether the problem sits on the client's network or with the provider. If it is the provider's, you open the carrier ticket, supply the evidence and see it through. You own the fault until it is resolved or handed on with a complete diagnosis.


Given who our clients are, you will work to a high standard of security and documentation, and we train and support you to meet it.

**Work Environment and Location Requirements**
----------------------------------------------


You work from a home office in Red Lake with a private workspace and a reliable internet connection. Road travel to clients around Red Lake is a regular part of the week. Pikangikum is reached by air year\-round, by winter road from January to March and by boat in the warmer months, and some visits include an overnight stay. A valid driver's licence and reliable transportation are essential.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Take client requests by phone, email, portal and onsite; triage, diagnose, and resolve or escalate within service levels
* Troubleshoot network faults end to end: cabling and switch ports, Wi\-Fi, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, VPN clients and the internet connection, and manage carrier tickets with test evidence through to resolution
* Administer Microsoft 365 for managed clients: user lifecycle, licensing, Exchange Online, Entra ID and Intune
* Deploy and support Windows devices with Autopilot and Intune, along with mobile devices, printers, VoIP handsets and network equipment
* Keep documentation current for every ticket, client and site you work on
* Follow FSET information security policies and procedures without exception

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 2\+ years of IT support at an MSP or in a multi\-client environment, including hands\-on administration of Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune
* Hands\-on TCP/IP troubleshooting: you read ipconfig, ping, tracert and nslookup output with ease, understand DHCP, DNS, subnetting, NAT and VLANs, and can isolate a fault to the local network or the internet provider
* Live in or relocate to Red Lake, hold a valid full driver's licence, and travel regionally by road, air and water
* Fluent professional English, written and verbal, a clear criminal record check, and eligibility for the security screening our law enforcement clients require

**Preferred Qualifications (Assets)**
-------------------------------------

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, or ITIL Foundation
* Experience supporting business VoIP or UCaaS
* Experience supporting government or other regulated sectors
* Experience working with First Nations communities and organizations
* RMM or PSA platform migration experience
* French

**Professional Attributes**
---------------------------

* You explain technical problems in plain language to people who are not technical
* You work reliably on your own, with sound judgement about when to bring in help
* You are organized, punctual, and careful with detail and documentation
* You respect each community's protocols and ways of working
* You can kneel, bend and work in tight or restricted spaces

**Schedule and Availability**
-----------------------------

* Monday to Friday, 8\-hour day shift
* Four\-day work week available after successful completion of probation, as an earned privilege
* Rotational on\-call
* Occasional evenings, weekends and statutory holidays as client needs require, with time in lieu where extended hours are warranted

**Compensation and Benefits Package**
-------------------------------------

* Health, dental, extended health and vision coverage
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program for mental health and wellness
* RRSP matching
* Paid vacation, personal days and sick leave
* Paid training, plus industry certification support and reimbursement

**Why Join FSET**
-----------------

* Work that matters to the communities you live and travel in
* A clear promotion path from Support Analyst to Senior Support Analyst
* Colleagues who back you up when you are the only one on site

jobs.description:
About the Position

Niagara Belco Elevator Inc. is hiring an **Stairlift Diagnostics \& Field Support Technician** to serve as the technical backbone for our installation and service teams. This is a hands\-on, electromechanical role focused on fault\-finding and remote diagnostic support for stairlifts, vertical platform lifts, and related accessibility equipment.

The work is roughly two\-thirds electrical (control systems, wiring, power) and one\-third mechanical (drives, motors, rails). You will spend your day helping technicians on site solve real\-world equipment problems, not answering computer or software questions.

**Please note:** This is not an IT, helpdesk, software, or call\-centre position. Candidates whose background is mainly in computer or application support will not be considered.

What You'll Do

* Act as the first point of contact for technicians who need help diagnosing lift faults in the field
* Walk installers and service techs through fault\-finding steps by phone, email, and video
* Trace electrical faults across controllers, PCBs, harnesses, limit switches, sensors, and power supplies
* Identify and resolve mechanical problems involving motors, gear assemblies, rail alignment, and drive mechanisms
* Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, exploded views, and manufacturer service manuals
* Recommend repairs, part replacements, and adjustments based on diagnostic findings
* Keep clear records of reported issues, root causes, and fixes to build an internal knowledge base
* Escalate complex cases to equipment manufacturers and coordinate advanced troubleshooting
* Identify recurring failure patterns and share findings with the service and installation teams
* Assist with bench testing of returned or suspect components as needed

What We're Looking For

* Proven electrical fault\-finding skills with low\-voltage systems, controls, and wiring
* Solid mechanical aptitude, including motors, moving assemblies, alignment, and wear parts
* Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and mechanical drawings
* Clear communicator who can guide a technician through a repair over the phone
* Patient, methodical approach to troubleshooting
* Comfortable supporting trades professionals in the field rather than end users
* Hands\-on experience with stairlifts, elevators, platform lifts, escalators, or similar electromechanical equipment is a strong asset

This Role Is NOT

* IT or desktop support
* Helpdesk or software troubleshooting
* Network, server, or application support
* Call\-centre style customer service

Experience

* Electrical troubleshooting: 1 year (required)
* Electrical schematic reading: 1 year (required)

Pay: $20\.00\-$22\.00 per hour

* Extended health care
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

* Demonstrated time\-management skills with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet deadlines with minimal supervision
* Demonstrated problem solving and decision making skills
* Effective oral communication and strong interpersonal skills; excellent written communication skills; attention to detail and accuracy
* Demonstrated customer service skills at a level to develop and maintain cooperative/collaborative working relationships both within and outside the organization
* Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and tact and maintain a high degree of confidentiality at all times, complying with all applicable privacy legislation and local policies and procedures

jobs.title: Field Service Technician – Drilling Equipment
jobs.description:
CATEGORY Mid\-level
  

LOCATION Sudbury, ON
  

JOB TYPE Full\-time twelve\-month contract
  



**What**
**You’ll**
**Do**
--------------------------


MEDATech Engineering Services is looking for a Sudbury\-based Field Service Technician to provide hands\-on technical support for a MEDATech drill deployment near Chapleau, Ontario. This role sits at the intersection of field service and engineering: you’ll be the person on\-site keeping the equipment running, troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and control system issues in real time, while also feeding what you learn in the field back into MEDATech’s engineering team to improve the product. You’ll split your time between the customer site and MEDATech’s Sudbury\-area base, consisting of regular travel to Chapleau, Ontario for commissioning, troubleshooting, and scheduled service work. This…


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* **Field Support** – Provide on\-site commissioning, troubleshooting, and repair support for MEDATech’s drill and associated systems at the Chapleau\-area customer site, including diagnosing and correcting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and control system failures.
* **Root Cause Analysis** – Analyze equipment failures in the field, determine root cause, and implement short\- and long\-term corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* **Customer Support** – Act as the primary technical point of contact on\-site, building strong working relationships with customer operations and maintenance personnel, and communicating equipment performance and issues back to MEDATech.
* **Electrical \& Controls Troubleshooting** – Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control system logic to diagnose faults; work with PLC/control systems as required.
* **Mechanical \& Hydraulic Troubleshooting** – Read and interpret mechanical and hydraulic drawings and assembly diagrams; diagnose and repair hydraulic and mechanical systems on drill equipment.
* **Engineering Feedback Loop** – Document field issues, failure modes, and equipment performance, and work with MEDATech’s engineering team to drive design improvements and reliability fixes.
* **Reporting** – Prepare field service reports, time studies, equipment performance summaries, and technical documentation as required to support the customer relationship and internal engineering review.
* **Parts \& Logistics** – Identify parts and component needs arising from field repairs, and assist with parts sourcing and installation, provide input for cost estimates for repair and support work.
* **Health \& Safety** – Strict adherence to MEDATech and client health and safety policies at mining and remote sites.

### **Position Qualifications and Requirements****:**


* Post\-secondary diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related field; **or,** a Certificate of Qualification as a heavy\-duty/construction equipment mechanic or millwright with equivalent hands\-on field experience
* Minimum 2–3 years of hands\-on field service experience with heavy mobile equipment, drills, or similar mining/construction machinery
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical schematics and assembly drawings
* Working knowledge of hydraulic systems and electrical/electronic control systems
* Comfortable working with hand and power tools, and performing hands\-on disassembly, reassembly, and commissioning work
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
* Willingness to travel regularly to the Chapleau\-area site, including extended overnight stays as required
* Willingness to respond to occasional after\-hours or weekend calls to support site operations

### **Considered an asset:**


* Experience with drilling equipment specifically (surface or underground)
* 2D/3D CAD experience (SolidWorks, SolidWorks Electrical, AutoCAD)
* PLC or control systems experience
* MOL underground mining site training/orientation modules (Program \#770010\)

### **The Right Candidate Would Demonstrate****:**


* Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to think through mechanical, electrical, controls and hydraulic problems systematically
* Comfort working independently on\-site with minimal day\-to\-day supervision, while staying closely connected to the home engineering team
* Exceptional communication skills — able to translate field issues into clear technical feedback for engineering, and explain solutions clearly to customer personnel
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in troubleshooting and documentation
* Self\-motivation and the initiative to see problems through to resolution
* Flexibility and adaptability, given the remote and variable nature of field deployment work
* Strong time management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure

### **Compensation****:**


**Base salary: $85,000 – $115,000/year**, commensurate with experience, plus applicable overtime and travel/site premiums for time spent at the Chapleau\-area deployment.


*If you have these qualifications and are interested in joining a growing engineering and manufacturing company, please forward your resume and cover letter. While we appreciate the interest of all applicants, we will contact only those candidates selected for an interview.*


*MEDATech is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building and maintaining an inclusive work environment. We recognize the strength of diversity and encourage applications from all qualified candidates. Accommodation through our recruitment process is available to applicants upon request.*

RESPECT \| ACCOUNTABILITY \| INTEGRITY \| SERVICE \| COLLABORATION

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst II
jobs.description:
Discover TRIUMF , Canada's particle accelerator centre. We are a publicly funded, not\-for\-profit research lab that is a hub for discovery and innovation.


Our mission is to serve as Canada’s particle accelerator centre. We advance isotope science and technology, both fundamental and applied. We collaborate across communities and disciplines, from nuclear and particle physics to the life and material sciences. We discover and innovate, inspire and educate, creating knowledge and opportunity for all.


TRIUMF's diverse community of nearly 600 multidisciplinary researchers, engineers, technicians, tradespeople, staff, and students create a unique incubator for Canadian excellence, as well as a portal to premier global collaborations. Fueling innovation and improving lives, we are committed to accelerating discovery and shaping a better world.  



  

**Are you a cybersecurity professional with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in technical risk, security architecture, detection engineering, or identity security?**

  

You could be a great fit if you bring:  



  

* **Cybersecurity risk expertise:** Lead technical security risk assessments across systems, applications, infrastructure, and projects, identifying vulnerabilities and evaluating whether security controls can effectively prevent or detect real\-world attacks
* **Security architecture expertise:** Review networks, cloud environments, applications, and enterprise systems to identify security weaknesses, assess data flows, perform threat modeling, and provide secure design guidance
* **Detection engineering:** Develop, test, maintain, and improve SIEM, EDR, and other security detection content, while mapping detection coverage to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework and addressing security gaps
* **Identity \& access management:** Assess and strengthen IAM environments, including MFA, SSO, privileged access management, federation, directory services, and zero\-trust access controls
* **Incident response \& investigation:** Provide senior technical support during complex cybersecurity incidents, from detection and triage through containment, recovery, and root cause analysis
* **Vulnerability \& threat intelligence:** Evaluate vulnerabilities based on exploitability and asset criticality, monitor emerging threats, and translate threat intelligence into practical security improvements
* **Technical leadership \& mentorship:** Serve as a senior technical resource, providing guidance, coaching, and work review for junior and intermediate cybersecurity analysts

  

**Why TRIUMF?**

  

* Work at Canada’s national particle accelerator centre and contribute to cybersecurity in a unique scientific research environment
* Collaborate with a multidisciplinary community of researchers, engineers, technicians, IT professionals, and scientists
* Grow your career through technical leadership, mentorship, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced research environments
Enjoy a comprehensive total rewards package, including employer\-paid health and dental benefits, vision care, pension, disability benefits, wellness benefits, and generous time away  
* 

  

  

**PRIMARY FUNCTION:**

The Cybersecurity Analyst II applies deep technical expertise across a broad range of cybersecurity disciplines to evaluate and reduce risk across the organization's systems, infrastructure, and projects. The primary focus of the role is technical risk assessment and security architecture review, examining how systems are built, how they could be attacked, and whether controls in place would actually stop an adversary. In addition, the incumbent owns detection engineering and identity and access management security as core functions, ensuring the organization's defensive capabilities are built on sound design and continuously strengthened. The incumbent operates with minimal direction, exercises independent judgment on complex and ambiguous problems, and is trusted to make sound, technically grounded security decisions.  



  

The ideal candidate thinks like an attacker and advises like a trusted advisor. They bring hands\-on experience across threat modeling, attack surface analysis, detection content development, identity security architecture, and incident response, and can translate technical risk clearly and credibly to project teams, system owners, and leadership. This role also serves as a senior technical resource for the broader cybersecurity team, providing mentorship and guidance to junior analysts.  



  

**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

The Cybersecurity Team is a group of the Information Systems and Technology Department (IS\&T). The Cybersecurity Analyst II reports directly to the Group Leader, Cybersecurity, and interacts on a day\-to\-day basis with other members of IS\&T and with a broad range of internal stakeholders, system owners, and research groups. This position works with colleagues across all areas of the Lab and in all job functions. External contacts include vendors, consultants, and support service providers.  



  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Technical Risk Assessment**

* Lead technical cybersecurity risk assessments of systems, applications, infrastructure, and projects.
* Evaluate control effectiveness to determine whether existing safeguards would realistically detect or prevent an attack.
* Evaluate third\-party and vendor security posture prior to onboarding and on an ongoing basis.
* Communicate risk findings with technical precision to technical stakeholders and in plain institutional impact terms to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to risk reporting for governance and leadership forums as a secondary output of technical work.

**Security Architecture Review**

* Review the security design of proposed and existing systems, networks, applications, and cloud deployments.
* Assess data flows and sensitive data exposure risks as part of architecture reviews, escalating findings to the appropriate owner.
* Perform threat

* Troubleshoot basic networking issues including Wi\-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, DNS, and DHCP.
* Perform routine maintenance, updates, and system checks.
* Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions accurately within ticketing and documentation systems.
* Escalate complex issues to senior technicians as required.
* Participate in client onboarding projects, technology assessments, migrations, and hardware deployments.

* Maintain a professional and positive client experience during all interactions.
* Utilize AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and other modern productivity tools to improve troubleshooting, research, documentation, and overall efficiency.
* Participate in an after\-hours on\-call rotation to support urgent client issues when scheduled.

**Qualifications**

Required

* Diploma, degree, or certification in Information Technology, Computer Systems Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Strong knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11\.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts including:
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* VPN
* Wireless Networking
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Professional, dependable, and customer\-focused attitude.
* Comfortable leveraging AI\-powered tools to improve productivity and service delivery.

**Driving Requirements**

This role includes regular travel to client locations using a company vehicle.

Applicants must:

* Hold a valid Alberta Class 5 driver's license.
* Have a clean driving record.
* Be insurable under the company's vehicle insurance policy.
* Be comfortable driving throughout Calgary and surrounding Alberta communities.
* Represent CloudOrbis professionally while onsite at client locations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following qualifications are considered strong assets:

* Previous experience working for a Managed Services Provider (MSP).
* Experience supporting multiple clients and environments simultaneously.
* Experience with:
* Microsoft Intune
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Microsoft Azure
* Active Directory
* Windows Server
* Microsoft Defender
* Remote Monitoring \& Management (RMM) platforms
* Professional Services Automation (PSA) platforms
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, NinjaOne, Huntress, ConnectWise, Datto RMM, or similar tools.
* Microsoft certifications such as:
* MS\-900
* AZ\-900
* CompTIA certifications such as:
* A\+
* Network\+
* Security\+
* Experience using AI tools professionally to enhance troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate:

* Has a passion for technology and helping people.
* Enjoys troubleshooting and solving technical problems.
* Is curious, motivated, and eager to learn.
* Takes ownership of tasks and follows issues through to resolution.
* Communicates professionally with both technical and non\-technical users.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced MSP environment.
* Is organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
* Uses AI and modern technology tools to work smarter and more efficiently.
* Is reliable and willing to participate in an on\-call support rotation.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Company vehicle for client visits.
* Exposure to a broad range of technologies and business environments.
* Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
* Support for industry certifications and career growth.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Opportunity to work with Microsoft cloud technologies, cybersecurity solutions, and emerging AI tools.

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent

**Location:** Calgary, Alberta

**Work Arrangement:** On\-Site

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, plus participation in an after\-hours on\-call rotation.

Pay: $40,000\.00\-$45,000\.00 per year

jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Red Rhino Networks  


For the MSP technician who's ready to own the hard tickets and make the whole operation better.  


Red Rhino Networks is a Managed Service Provider supporting small and medium\-sized businesses across British Columbia. You already know what that means: many environments, real variety, and the good kind of hard problems. We're looking for a Systems Administrator who's past the “learning the basics” stage and wants a place where solving complex issues, mentoring other technicians, and improving how things run are all part of the actual job, not favours you do on the side.  


Why being a Systems Administrator here is different  


Most places tell you there's “room to grow” and leave it at that. We build the path:  


* You get a Personal Growth Plan. Your goals, written down, with time and budget behind them.
* A Skills Matrix shows you exactly where you stand today and what you're already good at.
* These form your growth roadmap which tells you precisely which skills move you to the next level. No guessing, no politics.

We plan for our clients' growth the same way we plan for yours.  


What you will do  


You'll own the escalations Tier 1 can't crack, the Entra ID and Intune misconfigurations, the mail\-flow mysteries, the network and firewall problems, the server and virtualization issues, the Azure and Microsoft 365 tenant work. You'll run point on small projects and migrations, go on\-site when a problem needs hands and judgment, and be the person a client trusts to explain what happened and why. Between tickets, you'll spot the recurring issue nobody's fixed at the root, write the documentation that stops it coming back, and build the small automation that saves the team an hour a week. You'll work across a modern MSP stack, Autotask for tickets, N\-able for monitoring and scripting, IT Glue for documentation, against real SLAs, with the autonomy to make good calls.  


What we're really looking for  


* You recognize patterns and clues quickly, but you can also reason from first principles when the problem doesn't fit something you've seen before.
* You own outcomes, not tickets. “Closed” and “actually fixed” are different things to you.
* You write documentation other people can follow, because you've been burned by bad docs.
* You look for the process or automation improvement, not just the next ticket in the queue.
* You communicate with clients confidently and plainly, especially when the news is bad.
* You use AI responsibly to work faster, and you think critically about the security and governance side of doing that.

Required  


* 3\+ years in an MSP or multi\-client environment (or comparable breadth), independently resolving Tier 2 and systems administration issues and escalations.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365 administration, and Entra ID.
* Real networking and firewall troubleshooting. You can follow the traffic and find the fault.
* A track record of clear documentation and confident client communication.
* Able to work in Canada and travel to client sites in the region (kilometres reimbursed).

Nice to have (please don't self\-select out if you don't have these)  


* Hands\-on experience with Intune, Azure, and virtualization platforms.
* Apple/macOS administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Graph API) beyond copy\-paste.
* Relevant certifications (Microsoft, networking, security), or the equivalent demonstrable skill.
* Experience mentoring or being the escalation point for junior techs.

We don't require a degree. Demonstrated ability and how you think matter more.  


To apply  


Please apply by responding to the application and attaching your resume and cover letter. We’d like to thank all those who apply. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  


Pay: $60,000\.00\-$80,000\.00 per year

Job Description:

Technical Support Engineers

Apex Systems is a global IT services provider, and our staffing practice has an opening in the Online Retail space for Technical Support Engineers with 1-2 years' experience in a similar role with experience in SQL, monitoring tools and jira experience to place at our client.

Start date:
ASAP.

Office Location:
100% remote (within Canada)

Hybrid:
preferred on weekly basis

Overview

Technical Support Engineers are key contributors to Our Client’s Platform Support organization.

In this role, you will leverage customer-facing expertise and be responsible for troubleshooting and addressing Our Client’s Enterprise Retailers' technical questions and platform issues including incidents. You will research and implement solutions to prevent or mitigate customer issues through a combination of proactive support and monitoring. You will partner with their Engineering team and other cross-functional teams to provide the highest level of support and subject matter expertise to some of our largest and most strategic accounts. This is a suitable career opportunity for a highly motivated, customer-centric, self-directed individual who is interested in learning and supporting a cutting-edge and rapidly changing e-commerce SaaS/mobile platform.

About The Job

Manage multiple priorities and own your work from end to end.
Manage incoming external and internal stakeholder requests via the JIRA Service Desk.
Solve complex challenges - use your research and superior communication to provide clear and accurate resolution paths on incoming tickets in accordance with SLA’s.
Recreate and replicate technical challenges with a mission to drive product change via configuration management, fixes, and deployments to client production and testing environments.
Contribute to the creation and enhancement of an application support specific customer knowledge base and document repository to be used for managing the technical specifics/requirements of each client.
Collaborate with our Product and Development Teams to build new features and fix bugs.

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree/Technical Diploma in a technical field or 6+ years of equivalent practical experience in a technical support role.
1-2 years of SaaS troubleshooting experience in a Technical Support capacity.
Technical experience and an understanding of
Relational databases (ex. Microsoft SQL Server)
Linux environment.
Telemetry & Logging Tools (ex. DataDog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Sentry)
The incident, Ticket Management tools, and various plug-ins/automated

workflows (ex. Jira).

Managing multiple testing environments (UAT, prod, etc.)
REST APIs, and how the web works.
Experience to look through and understand code using programming languages such as XML, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript/jQuery, Ruby, or similar.
Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
Communicate complex technical topics to customers and coworkers of varying technical skill levels.
Experience creating and maintaining customer-specific playbooks, SOPs (standard operating procedures), and operating manuals.
Experience in building strategic plans that enable handling multiple projects simultaneously.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Field Service Technician I provides service to all contracted Food Safety and Water Treatment accounts through efficient monitoring and application of service programs and procedures. This position performs routine troubleshooting, field installations and repairs of chemical feed and control equipment while maintaining high quality standards.

Essential Job Functions

Develop positive relationships by maintaining continuous contact with accounts to promote Company products
Perform scheduled service route in accordance with Division’s Minimum Service Standards
Handle and install various chemical dispensing and application equipment
Handle and apply treatment products in an environmentally safe manner
Perform analyses and evaluation of treatment programs to determine product effectiveness
Assess if product application changes/adjustments are necessary
Routinely troubleshoot for problem/solution identification
Install and repair all chemical feed, dispensing, application and control equipment
Provide service reports on status of existing programs at each account
Perform chemical cleanings and power washings of customer equipment
Make recommendations for improving existing treatment programs
Properly care for and maintain all Company-owned equipment including tools, instruments, safety equipment and vehicles
Comply with company safety standards including safe vehicle operation
Complete all administrative requirements including basic skills/safety training courses
Order inventory and supplies required to perform services
Ensure regular communication with service team members and sales personnel
Other similar and comparable duties as required and assigned

Education/ Special Licenses Or Certification

High school or technical school diploma or GED
Associate’s degree in science preferred
Valid driver’s license (clean driving record)

Experience

Two years of maintenance, sanitation, water treatment and/or food plant industry related experience preferred
Basic pipe fitting and electrical ability a plus
Working level knowledge of food and water treatment fundamentals, practices, and terminology
Previous maintenance of water treatment, cooling towers, boilers and closed loop systems

Skills

Strong mechanical, plumbing, and electrical skills
Competent use of tools & safety equipment
Chemical testing & interpretation
Basic understanding of water treatment, cooling towers, and closed loop systems
Computer skills including e-mail, Word, and Excel
Experience in maintenance and repairs – CIP, plumbing and electrical experience a plus

Competencies

Effective communication (Verbal, Listening & Written)
Analytical & Problem Solving
Customer/Vendor Relationship and solution focused
Drive for results
Action Oriented
Critical thinking
Planning & Priority Setting
Technical Knowledge
Teamwork
Trust
Administrative skills

Physical Requirements/ Working Conditions

Sit or stand for extended periods of time
Capability to move up to 60 lbs. by hand and 300lbs with use of hand truck
Ability to climb stairs and ladders
Visual acuity necessary to utilize computers and electronic devices
Extra hours and some travel may be required

jobs.description:
About The Role

Not just another entry level career opportunity: receive coaching, mentorship, and support at every step of your career journey. We invest in you so you can thrive and succeed.

Launch your tech career with FDM – any degree welcomed

Your degree got you here, your passion can take you further. Start a tech career that’s both dynamic and impactful. As an FDM Consultant, you’ll get the chance to work with global companies across banking, consulting, retail, insurance, and more. You’ll add big names to your resume and gaining hands-on experience from day one.

Serving a wide variety of industries, we can offer our consultants a career path in their most suited field. We help you develop and build on your strengths, behaviors, knowledge, and ability with hands-on, industry relevant coaching, and place you on assignments with leading global companies.

We match your strengths to the right role.
Opportunities could include, but not limited to:

Quality Engineer

Test software manually and with tools like Selenium and Cucumber, ensuring reliability, performance, and seamless user experiences across every release.

Cloud Developer

Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS or Azure using Java and React, optimizing for performance, scalability, and resilience.

Software Engineer

Design and build full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React, delivering scalable, secure, and responsive digital experiences.

About You

What’s in it for you?

Fast-track your career with 6-12 weeks initial upskilling courses facilitated by our expert coaches, followed by practice-based learning catered to industry demand
Opportunity to work on exciting, business-critical projects with top-tier companies in banking & finance, insurance, retail, and more
Dive into delivering solutions across the application lifecycle
No tech experience? No problem. If you’re analytical, tech-inclined, and love problem-solving, we’ll equip you with the skills to succeed in Software Engineering
With hands-on support and real client projects, you’ll be assignment-ready, and can grow into senior roles in just a few years
Build a diverse and rewarding career path with ongoing coaching through our Skills Lab
Consultant Experience Team to support your wellbeing, health, and happiness
Potential to qualify for relocation support

What we look for

You hold a university degree level (bachelor or higher)
Able to commit to at least two years of employment with FDM as a consultant following the initial training period
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, paired with great interpersonal and communication skills
Eligible to work in Canada
Please note that all client assignments will require on-site work in client offices. Office locations may include, but are not limited to, Toronto, Montreal, Halifax, Waterloo, and Calgary

During the initial period of upskilling, all hours worked will be compensated at the rate of $18.35/hour. Once on client assignment, the compensation for this position is $50,000 annually and this role may also be eligible for participation in FDM's bonus scheme.

About Us

FDM powers the people behind tech and innovation. We spot trends, find top talent, and help businesses stay ahead.

With 35+ years of experience, we coach, mentor, and launch fresh thinkers from diverse backgrounds into world-class careers. Partnering with top global companies, we deliver the right talent at the right time—while guiding our people toward exponential growth.

🌍 Global impact – 19 centers across North America, APAC, the UK, and Europe
🚀 25,000+ careers launched – and counting
🤝 300+ trusted client partners

Committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Tech careers should be for everyone. With 80+ nationalities represented, FDM thrives on diversity, fuels innovation through unique perspectives, and celebrates success together. As an Equal Opportunity Employer and FTSE4Good-listed company, we ensure every qualified applicant gets a fair shot—no barriers, just opportunities.
